author: Michael Saponara
title: Drake Releases 'FOMO' Four-Pack as 'HABIBTI' Deluxe Featuring Don Toliver: Stream It Now - NewsBreak
text:
By Michael Saponara ,
30 minutes ago Weeks after Drake premiered FOMO , four tracks from the short film have received an official release. The four-pack is packaged as the HABIBTI deluxe edition, featuring a pair of Don Toliver collaborations, and hit streaming services on Friday (Oct. 2).
Everything We Learned From Drake’s ‘FOMO’ Short Film
The deluxe includes “Cold Shoulder” featuring Don Toliver and Yebba, as well as “Solar Eclipse,” which interpolates Ella Langley’s record-breaking smash hit “Choosin’ Texas” — which has spent 24 weeks atop the Billboard Hot 100 and finds Toliver making another guest appearance. Rounding out the foursome, Drake brings “Quebec” and an extended version of HABIBTI ‘s “Classic” for “Classic Pt. 2.”
Drake initially revealed that tracks would be coming to streaming earlier this week while gambling during a Kick stream. “Go watch FOMO . It’s a bunch of songs coming to streaming on Thursday,” Drake said. “So, all the songs that you guys have been asking [about]. Well, not all of them. Enough of them are coming on Thursday. That’s it.”
One of the fan favorites from FOMO already landed on streaming, as Yeat made sure his “Miss My Dawg” collaboration with Drake was part of his COCOON EP in September.
The 6 God is coming off of his ICEMAN , HABIBTI and MAID OF HONOUR trifecta in May, which topped the top three slots of the Billboard 200 in May. He’s gearing up to hit the road for his first North American trek since 2023’s It’s All A Blur Tour, with a world tour on deck for next year.
Drake Says a ‘Bunch of Songs’ From ‘FOMO’ Short Film Are Coming to Streaming Services This Week
Two decades into his decorated career, Drake continues to raise the bar. ICEMAN ‘s “Janice STFU” became Drizzy’s longest-running No. 1 on the Hot Rap Songs chart, which earned a 19th week at the summit to break a tie with “Hotline Bling.”
